scene.label: Act 1, Scene 2
scene.title: SCENE II. Corioles. The Senate House

content.text: Enter Tullus Aufidius with Senators of Corioles.

lines.text: So, your opinion is, Aufidius,
lines.plainText: So your opinion is Aufidius

lines.text: That they of Rome are entered in our counsels
lines.plainText: That they of Rome are entered in our counsels

lines.text: And know how we proceed.
lines.plainText: And know how we proceed

lines.text: Is it not yours?
lines.plainText: Is it not yours

lines.text: What ever have been thought on in this state
lines.plainText: What ever have been thought on in this state

lines.text: That could be brought to bodily act ere Rome
lines.plainText: That could be brought to bodily act ere Rome

lines.text: Had circumvention? 'Tis not four days gone
lines.plainText: Had circumvention 'Tis not four days gone

lines.text: Since I heard thence. These are the words—I think
lines.plainText: Since I heard thence These are the wordsI think

lines.text: I have the letter here. Yes, here it is.
lines.plainText: I have the letter here Yes here it is

lines.text: [Reads.] They have pressed a power, but it is not known
lines.plainText: Reads They have pressed a power but it is not known

lines.text: Whether for east or west. The dearth is great.
lines.plainText: Whether for east or west The dearth is great

lines.text: The people mutinous; and, it is rumoured,
lines.plainText: The people mutinous and it is rumoured

lines.text: Cominius, Martius your old enemy,
lines.plainText: Cominius Martius your old enemy

lines.text: Who is of Rome worse hated than of you,—
lines.plainText: Who is of Rome worse hated than of you

lines.text: And Titus Lartius, a most valiant Roman,
lines.plainText: And Titus Lartius a most valiant Roman

lines.text: These three lead on this preparation
lines.plainText: These three lead on this preparation

lines.text: Whither 'tis bent. Most likely 'tis for you.
lines.plainText: Whither 'tis bent Most likely 'tis for you

lines.text: Consider of it.
lines.plainText: Consider of it

lines.text: Our army's in the field.
lines.plainText: Our army's in the field

lines.text: We never yet made doubt but Rome was ready
lines.plainText: We never yet made doubt but Rome was ready

lines.text: To answer us.
lines.plainText: To answer us

lines.text: Nor did you think it folly
lines.plainText: Nor did you think it folly

lines.text: To keep your great pretences veiled till when
lines.plainText: To keep your great pretences veiled till when

lines.text: They needs must show themselves, which, in the hatching,
lines.plainText: They needs must show themselves which in the hatching

lines.text: It seemed, appeared to Rome. By the discovery
lines.plainText: It seemed appeared to Rome By the discovery

lines.text: We shall be shortened in our aim, which was
lines.plainText: We shall be shortened in our aim which was

lines.text: To take in many towns ere almost Rome
lines.plainText: To take in many towns ere almost Rome

lines.text: Should know we were afoot.
lines.plainText: Should know we were afoot

lines.text: Noble Aufidius,
lines.plainText: Noble Aufidius

lines.text: Take your commission; hie you to your bands.
lines.plainText: Take your commission hie you to your bands

lines.text: Let us alone to guard Corioles.
lines.plainText: Let us alone to guard Corioles

lines.text: If they set down before's, for the remove
lines.plainText: If they set down before's for the remove

lines.text: Bring up your army. But I think you'll find
lines.plainText: Bring up your army But I think you'll find

lines.text: They've not prepared for us.
lines.plainText: They've not prepared for us

lines.text: O, doubt not that;
lines.plainText: O doubt not that

lines.text: I speak from certainties. Nay, more,
lines.plainText: I speak from certainties Nay more

lines.text: Some parcels of their power are forth already,
lines.plainText: Some parcels of their power are forth already

lines.text: And only hitherward. I leave your Honours.
lines.plainText: And only hitherward I leave your Honours

lines.text: If we and Caius Martius chance to meet,
lines.plainText: If we and Caius Martius chance to meet

lines.text: 'Tis sworn between us we shall ever strike
lines.plainText: 'Tis sworn between us we shall ever strike

lines.text: Till one can do no more.
lines.plainText: Till one can do no more

lines.text: The gods assist you!
lines.plainText: The gods assist you

lines.text: And keep your Honours safe!
lines.plainText: And keep your Honours safe

lines.text: Farewell.
lines.plainText: Farewell

lines.text: Farewell.
lines.plainText: Farewell

lines.text: Farewell.
lines.plainText: Farewell
